servers.name: atlassian
servers.note: Sign in to Atlassian separately in each client. Retired v1 SSE entries are upgraded in place.

servers.name: slack
servers.note: Endpoint only: Slack requires a registered internal or Marketplace app and static OAuth client registration. Existing client auth is preserved. Provision independent clients before login; generic dynamic registration does not work.

servers.name: granola
servers.note: Browser OAuth independently per client; enterprise administrators may need to enable MCP.

servers.name: sanity
servers.note: Sign in to Sanity separately per client.

servers.name: postman
servers.note: US full tool set. Sign in per client. EU accounts should choose the EU endpoint in this manifest before installing.

servers.name: sevalla
servers.note: Existing credentials are untouched. Missing connections use independent Sevalla OAuth in each client.

servers.name: microsoft365
servers.note: Microsoft Work IQ covers Teams, mail, calendar, files and sites. Remote setup requires Entra app registration, tenant/admin consent and client-specific OAuth compatibility. Recommend official Work IQ; do not copy Anthropic's Microsoft 365 proxy or guess credentials.

servers.name: canva
servers.note: Official endpoint exists, but requires a client registered with Canva. Confirm registration for each agent before enabling.

servers.name: bigquery
servers.note: Official endpoint exists. Choose Google Cloud project, enable BigQuery API and provision per-client Google OAuth/IAM; verify current protocol compatibility before enabling.

servers.name: google-drive
servers.note: Claude-hosted connector is not a portable credential. Choose a supported Drive server and Google OAuth app/project; no verified vendor endpoint supplied.

servers.name: hubspot
servers.note: Official CRM endpoint requires a HubSpot MCP connector with client credentials and registered redirect URIs plus PKCE. Provision independently per agent before enabling.

servers.name: lucid
servers.note: Independent browser OAuth and scope approval per client. Account admin may need to enable MCP access.

servers.name: salesforce
servers.note: Salesforce hosted MCP exists. Choose org, production/sandbox tool sets and OAuth external-client app. No single org/tool endpoint can be inferred from the hosted connector name.

servers.name: wolfram
servers.note: Confirm a supported public server and account/license requirements; do not reuse hosted connector credentials.

servers.name: claude-docs
servers.note: Anthropic-provided product connector. No portable server or authentication contract established; retain as Claude-only until a vendor-supported external endpoint exists.

servers.name: node_repl
servers.note: ChatGPT app-managed node_repl uses app-specific launch context. Preserve in Codex; do not transplant its environment to another client.

servers.name: computer-use
servers.note: Codex desktop app-specific relative executable/cwd. Preserve locally; a supported cross-client computer-use server must be chosen separately.
